app_info.subtitle: Sponsor change checks
app_info.description: RegEvidenceHub Sponsor helps employers and advisers check how defined employee or organisation changes affect UK Skilled Worker sponsor duties. It covers salary, role, work-location, absence, delayed-start, stopping-sponsorship, TUPE, merger, takeover, and related change events. It returns explicit AFFECTED, NOT_AFFECTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, or INSUFFICIENT_INPUT states with official GOV.UK evidence and does not provide legal advice or Home Office approval.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns bounded service scope, supported events, and decision-state metadata without writing logs or external records on the OpenAI surface.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, contact the Home Office, or modify any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, submit, or perform irreversible sponsor actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the bounded local sponsor-change event catalogue and rule-pack metadata without changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to GOV.UK, the Home Office, or any other external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter sponsor records, licences, users, or external data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads maintained official-source freshness and review state without mutating the source-monitoring state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not perform external writes or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete evidence, alter source records, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a deterministic sponsor-change preflight from supplied facts and maintained evidence state without logging or changing external records on the OpenAI surface.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not report to the Home Office, submit forms, send messages, or modify third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot submit sponsor actions, revoke sponsorship, delete records, or perform transactions.

test_cases.user_prompt: A Skilled Worker has been absent without permission for 11 consecutive working days. Do we need to report it?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an evidence-linked AFFECTED result for the supported Skilled Worker scenario with the required sponsor action and no claim of Home Office approval.

test_cases.description: Assess a salary reduction when the same salary option remains met.
test_cases.user_prompt: We are reducing a Skilled Worker employee's salary, but the same salary option is still met. What is the sponsor impact?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the deterministic salary-change result using only the supplied facts and includes evidence-linked next-action information.

test_cases.user_prompt: Our sponsored Skilled Worker is moving to permanent remote work rather than hybrid-only working. Check the reporting impact.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the bounded work-location change result and required action without inferring unprovided facts.

test_cases.description: List the supported sponsor-change event types.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which Skilled Worker sponsor-change event types can this checker assess?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the bounded supported-event catalogue and rule-pack metadata.

test_cases.user_prompt: Is the GOV.UK sponsor guidance used by this checker current or under review?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded source freshness and review status and does not turn source health into a legal conclusion.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for employee visa-application advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Help me complete my personal Skilled Worker visa application and choose which documents to upload.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because individual visa applications are outside employer sponsor-change preflight.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for right-to-work verification.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Verify this employee's right-to-work share code and tell me whether I can hire them.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because right-to-work identity verification is outside its supported sponsor-change workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for payroll calculations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Calculate PAYE, National Insurance, and net pay for this employee's salary.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because payroll and tax calculations are outside its sponsor-compliance scope.
